data.body: 2026-09-28: after an app restart, MCP calls failed for ~8 min with "no MCP transport peer is installed for this application generation". Root cause: complete_question in desktop/src-tauri/src/runtime/service.rs staged the answer then resumed the pass without reconnecting the Chat's frozen MCP endpoints — the mirror of the approval path task 155 fixed. A question answered in a new process resumed the Run with no McpToolRuntimeV1 peer for that run id, so every mcp:// call failed in open_frozen until a fresh turn rebuilt its request. Evidence: chat.4ccbad85 spans 3021-3115 (17:46:16-17:46:53) failed right after a question answer; the next fresh turn worked. Fix: self.restore_frozen_mcp(&frozen.context) before accepting that work. Test: answering_a_question_reconnects_the_chats_frozen_mcp_endpoints fails without it, passes with it; 505 lib tests pass; validated live after a restart. Open: a denied approval still resumes without the reconnect.
